author: Copilot
body: This test name says "without config" but it actually verifies that admission waiting is disabled when `request_batch_max_wait_ms` is 0. Renaming it avoids confusion, and the re-initialize is redundant with `setup_method`.

author: Copilot
body: `get_admission_wait_decision` can return `should_wait=True` even when `max_num_running_reqs == 1` (serial execution). In that case, admission waiting cannot increase batch size and only adds latency; it should be disabled when `max_batch <= 1`.
